protocol.frames: 14 rendered frames (24 fps, 0-0.54 s) -> 64 by nearest repetition; V-JEPA tubelet 2 -> 32 steps; times in seconds
protocol.law_mapping: PAC-NeRF elastic -> jelly; PAC-NeRF plasticine (von Mises) -> elastoplastic = metal or plasticine (binary score); 3-class score uses GT=metal (von Mises without softening) as reference

adaptation.offset: z += mean support residual per parameter (E, nu, sigma_y; sigma_y only from support scenes with yield)
adaptation.ridge_last_layer: last Linear of param_head, delta on mean outputs; ridge lambda = 1.0 * mean ||h||^2, bias unpenalized
adaptation.law_head: law_head refit with CE on support, 100 Adam steps lr 0.01, L2-to-init 0.01
adaptation.support: other 3 scenes, all 3 camera triplets; query = held-out scene canonical triplet t0 (also mean over t0-t2)
adaptation.support_mean_baseline: reference without video: predict the mean GT z of the 3 support scenes (law logits = K0)

protocol.caveat: 4 scenes, 1 sequence each, free fall only; qualitative check, no statistics
